title: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound

result.label: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound
result.statement: Proves that any finite sequence in the Euclidean unit ball of ℝ d admits signs keeping every partial sum within C d, independently of length. Consequently every zero-sum family can be reordered with the same bound on unsigned partial sums. A matching lower bound gives the optimal order S2(d)= ( d).
